# Resizable

Panels people resize by dragging the line between them.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Brand expressive</span> Resizable is for desktop tools and not phones. Visitors come from social posts on their phones, and Brand expressive avoids tools people use for hours. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./card">Card</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Desktop tools where people choose how much space each panel gets.
- **Not when:** Phones, or layouts with one obvious shape.

Instead:

- [Sidebar](./sidebar.md): Fixed app navigation.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | The handle can be focused and moved with arrow keys. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add resizable
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Resizable reads 3 of Brand expressive's tokens. Each row follows one part of the component from its class to the value it ends at, in every theme. Change a token in the scheme and every component that reads it follows.
